jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Team

Our Login and MFA team owns the most consequential surface in software: the exact moment someone proves who they are. Getting this right means designing security that's invisible when it works, flows that guide without friction, and experiences that people trust without thinking twice. We're looking for a designer who obsesses over the details that make that possible.

You'll join a distributed and diverse team of designers who see design as both craft and catalyst. We believe design is never static, it evolves with our users, our products, and our own curiosity. Some days that means diving deep into research and validation, others it's refining existing flows, and often it's imagining bold new ways to move our product forward.

Our team thrives on collaboration and feedback. We learn from one another, challenge ourselves to raise the bar, and create space to experiment and grow. Designers here have real ownership, influencing product direction alongside engineering and product management while shaping experiences that reach millions of people worldwide.

If you're energized by complex problems, motivated to push boundaries, and eager to hone your craft while making a lasting impact, this is the place to do it.

The Role

As a Staff Product Designer, you'll tackle some of the hardest design challenges in identity: making authentication seamless for end users while remaining powerful and configurable for the developers who build on it. You'll lead design across Auth0's key login and multi factor authentication flows by guiding strategy and raising the craft.

What you'll be doing

When everyone on the team can generate UI, the designer's role shifts. You become the person responsible for strong systems thinking, taste, quality, experience, and being the voice of the customer. You hold the quality bar when speed is pushing everything toward "fine."

• Prototype at volume: Use AI tools and code to explore dozens of directions fast, then narrow based on what works and what solves the actual problem. The artifacts you create will be functional and inclusive of all Auth0 developer interfaces.

• Simplify complexity: Shape intuitive, scalable experiences for our customers with high standards for security and composability. You'll be designing customization journeys that make secure and frictionless authentication seamless.

• Raise the craft: Help the broader design org see what this way of working looks like in practice. We're all figuring this out together. You'll take pride in expanding your contributions through code and research-driven insights.

What you'll bring to the role

• You have craft: This matters most. Considered typography, intentional spacing, polished micro-interactions, details that show someone genuinely cared. We're looking for someone with a refined sense of design taste and a deep appreciation for the details that create a polished, trustworthy experience.

• You build: You've established a mature AI workflow that helps you bring ideas to life quickly. Instead of letting the backlog of small design debt collect, you take action and fix things directly in code.

• You have a real AI practice: Not experimentation, but an actual workflow. You have opinions about where AI tools help and where they fall short.

• You simplify: Auth0 is a robust and composable product. It is your job to create clarity and moments of magic amidst the complexity.

Note for when applying

In your application, please include a link to your portfolio with password (if protected). We prioritize a review of your design craft and any examples of your work in code.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Team

The Security team protects Anthropic's AI systems and maintains the trust of our users and society.

About the Role

At Anthropic, we are pioneering new frontiers in AI that have the potential to greatly benefit society. However, developing advanced AI also comes with risks if not properly safeguarded. As a Research Engineer, you'll help to safely advance the capabilities of our models in incident response, security analysis, vulnerability remediation, and other areas of defensive cybersecurity.

This role blends research and engineering, requiring you to both develop novel approaches and realize them in code. Your work will include designing and implementing RL environments, conducting experiments and evaluations, delivering your work into production training runs, and collaborating with other researchers, engineers, and cybersecurity specialists across and outside Anthropic.

This role requires ML experience combined with domain expertise in cybersecurity. You might be an ML researcher with a history of cybersecurity work, or a security professional with a background in ML.

Responsibilities

• Partner with researchers and safety teams across Anthropic to understand their analytical needs and build solutions

• Develop agentic integrations that allow AI systems to autonomously investigate and act on analytical findings

• Contribute to the strategic direction of the team, including decisions about what to build, what to partner on, and where to invest

• This role may require participation in an on-call rotation.

You may be a good fit if you

• Have experience with machine learning.

• Have experience in cybersecurity research.

• Have strong software engineering skills.

• Can balance research exploration with engineering implementation.

• Are passionate about AI's potential and committed to developing safe and beneficial systems.

Strong candidates may also have

• Professional experience in security engineering, fuzzing, detection and response, or other applied defensive work.

• Experience participating in or building CTF competitions and cyber ranges.

• Academic research experience in cybersecurity or other experimental & research background.

• Familiarity with RL techniques and environments.

• Familiarity with LLM training methodologies.

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

About the Team
OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops AI-native silicon and system-level solutions for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. Building on efforts like Jalapeño, the team is developing future generations of AI-native silicon and tightly integrated systems to power the next generation of frontier models. By co-designing chips, systems, tools, and methodologies, the team helps deliver faster, more efficient, and production-ready hardware for OpenAI’s supercomputing platform.
About the Role
We’re looking for a Silicon Design Lead to drive architecture, microarchitecture, and implementation of key IP and subsystems for our AI hardware platforms. You will translate functional, performance, and security requirements into efficient silicon designs, owning technical decisions from architectural definition through implementation and integration.
Part of this role will focus on hardware security implementation in close partnership with OpenAI’s Security team. While the Security team owns the overarching security architecture and requirements, you will translate those requirements into silicon microarchitecture and implementation, balancing security capabilities with performance, power, area, and design complexity. The other part of this role will focus on driving general silicon architecture/microarchitecture.
In this role, you will:
• Own architecture, microarchitecture, and implementation of silicon IP and subsystems, from requirements and design specifications through integration and validation.

• Define hardware interfaces, data flows, and microarchitectural tradeoffs to meet functional, performance, power, and area requirements.

• Partner closely with OpenAI’s Security team to translate security architecture, requirements, and threat models into implementable hardware capabilities.

• Design and integrate hardware security mechanisms, including encryption, key management, access controls, isolation, and data protection across silicon subsystems.

• Evaluate architectural and implementation tradeoffs to ensure security capabilities meet functional and performance requirements.

• Collaborate with silicon architects, RTL, verification, firmware, and software teams to drive subsystem design, integration, and validation.

• Review and contribute to RTL implementations, ensuring designs align with architectural intent and system requirements.

• Evaluate existing and third-party IP, identify architectural or implementation gaps, and drive solutions across subsystem boundaries.

You might thrive in this role if you:
• Have strong experience in silicon IP or subsystem-level architecture, microarchitecture, and implementation.

• Have owned hardware IP or subsystem designs from architectural definition through implementation and integration.

• Have experience implementing hardware security features such as memory encryption, key management, access controls, isolation, or secure boot.

• Understand how to translate functional and security requirements into hardware architectures, interfaces, and microarchitectural specifications.

• Have working knowledge of RTL design and coding proficiency in Verilog or SystemVerilog, with the ability to read, review, and contribute to RTL.

• Can evaluate performance, power, area, and complexity tradeoffs across silicon designs.

• Work effectively across security, silicon architecture, RTL, verification, firmware, and software teams to drive designs from concept through execution.

• Ideally, have broader SoC-level architecture or integration experience, though deep IP or subsystem-level expertise is sufficient.

To comply with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidates for this role may need to meet certain legal status requirements as provided in those laws and regulations.

About OpenAI
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

Who are we?
Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.
We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.
We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.
We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Role Overview:
Design and implement novel research ideas, ship state of the art models to production, and maintain deep connections to academia and the government. We have one of the highest ratio of compute to engineers in the world. We do not delineate strongly between engineering and research. Everyone will contribute to writing production code and conducting research depending on individual interest and organizational needs. We have all the compute, data, and talent available for you to do your best work.

Key Responsibilities:
• Design, build and scale agentic AI systems for serving mission critical use cases.

• Research, implement, and experiment with ideas on our supercompute and data infrastructure.

• Learn from and work with the best researchers in the field.

• Execute across the full AI stack and ship products to serve public interest.

Qualifications:
• Canadian citizenship and eligibility for security clearance ( required for this role ).

• Extremely strong software engineering skills.

• Proficiency in Python and related ML frameworks.

• Experience training, evaluating, and using (as an end-user) LLMs.

• Experience using large-scale distributed (GPU) LLM training strategies.

• Bonus : paper at top-tier venues (such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AIStats, MLSys, JMLR, AAAI, Nature, COLING, ACL, EMNLP).

Working Location:
This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role.

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:
• A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

• Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

• RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

• 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

• Annual enrichment benefits:
Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

• 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

• Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:
• Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

• For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

• For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

• Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form , and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

Reddit is continuing to grow our teams with the best talent. This role is completely remote friendly within the United States. If you happen to live close to one of our physical office locations (San Francisco, Los Angeles, New York City & Chicago) our doors are open for you to come into the office as often as you'd like.

Safety is central to Reddit’s mission and long-term health. Safety & Mods Data Science operates as a closed-loop system: Safety Insights helps the organization understand, measure, and prioritize risk, while Safety Enforcement Data Science builds and optimizes the models, rules, and systems that detect and mitigate abuse effectively, efficiently, and fairly.

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join Safety Enforcement Data Science. You will own one or more defined enforcement problem areas and translate ambiguous abuse risks and written policy into measurable signals, labels, detection approaches, actioning logic, and evaluation plans. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, Policy, Safety Operations, Threat Intelligence, and Safety Insights partners to turn analysis into scaled mitigation.

This is a hands-on role. You will investigate adversarial behavior, prototype and evaluate models and rules, tune decision thresholds, define launch guardrails, diagnose enforcement gaps, and monitor systems after deployment. You will also help the team use modern AI methods—including language models—where they improve detection, investigations, labeling, or operational workflows, with rigorous evaluation and appropriate human oversight.

This role may involve exposure to sensitive content and participation in an incident-response on-call rotation, including occasional work outside normal hours.

Responsibilities:

• Own the enforcement lifecycle. Lead a defined abuse or enforcement problem from problem framing and signal discovery through labels and taxonomies, model or rule development, thresholding, rollout, monitoring, and iteration.

• Discover and characterize abuse. Analyze large-scale behavioral, content, account, and network data to identify adversarial patterns, emerging threats, and gaps in existing mitigations.

• Build and evaluate decision systems . Develop models, classifiers, scoring systems, rules, and analytical prototypes using the statistical, machine-learning, or GenAI methods best suited to the problem.

• Define decision-quality standards. Create evaluation frameworks that address precision, recall, calibration, coverage, robustness, fairness, user friction, reviewer capacity, and other operational costs—not model performance in isolation.

• Ship with engineering partners. Partner with Engineering and Safety ML to productionize promising approaches; define data and logging needs, launch guardrails, monitoring and alerting, escalation paths, and rollback criteria.

• Translate policy into systems. Work with Policy and Safety Operations to convert written policy and product requirements into modelable targets, labels, decision rules, reviewer workflows, and measurable enforcement outcomes.

• Measure real-world impact. Design staged rollouts, experiments, and observational analyses that test whether interventions reduce harm while managing false positives and downstream effects on users, communities, and operations.

• Respond and learn. Support investigations and urgent escalations, identify mitigation options, conduct post-incident analyses, and turn one-time findings into durable detection or monitoring improvements.

• Scale the team’s effectiveness. Build reusable datasets, evaluation harnesses, monitoring tools, and documentation; communicate clear recommendations to technical and non-technical partners; and mentor junior peers when opportunities arise.

• Stay ahead of the threat landscape. Track emerging abuse tactics and advances in detection, adversarial ML, language models, synthetic data, and human-in-the-loop safety systems, and apply them pragmatically.

Required Qualifications:

• Education & Experience: Ph.D. with 4+ years OR Master’s degree with 8+ years* of relevant industry experience in Data Science, Applied Science, Economics, or a related quantitative role (e.g., Statistics, Computer Science, Operations Research).

• Applied experience in safety, enforcement engineering, fraud, or similar fast-paced, adversarial domains where data may be incomplete or evolving.

• Expertise in SQL and Python to write production-grade, reusable analytical code and contribute directly to data pipelines.

• Strong background in statistical analysis, experiment design, causal modeling, and ML techniques (e.g., classification, ranking, anomaly/pattern detection).

• Practical knowledge of evaluating real-world decision systems, including sampling, label quality, class imbalance, precision/recall, calibration, thresholding, drift, and monitoring.

• Proven ability to deconstruct ambiguous problems into scopable components, bias toward action, and drive impactful decisions alongside Product, Engineering, Operations, and Policy teams.

• Exceptional communication skills with demonstrated ability to convey complex technical concepts, tradeoffs, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience in Trust & Safety, integrity, fraud, spam and abuse, account security, cybersecurity, risk, content moderation, or another adversarial domain.

• Experience with one or more enforcement-relevant methods such as graph or network analysis, NLP, embeddings, sequence or behavioral modeling, weak supervision, synthetic data, or human-in-the-loop evaluation.

• Experience applying language models to detection, investigations, labeling, reviewer assistance, or workflow automation—and measuring quality, cost, latency, and safety tradeoffs.

• Experience partnering with engineers to launch and monitor models or rules in production, including incident response and post-launch tuning.

• Experience designing prioritization or triage systems for human review operations, including analysis of reviewer quality and capacity.

• Experience assessing fairness, bias, privacy, and policy-aware tradeoffs in automated decision systems.

Benefits:

• Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs

• 401k with Employer Match

• Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support

• Family Planning Support

• Gender-Affirming Care

• Mental Health & Coaching Benefits

• Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off

• Generous Paid Parental Leave

jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Senior AI-Native Designer & Builder, Design System to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Senior Manager, Product Design in the Product Management department.

You will participate in the evolution of Zscaler's design ecosystem to ensure product consistency, scalability, and excellence while collaborating closely with Design, Engineering, and cross-functional teams to set visual and structural standards. Working in a fast-paced environment, you design with intention and leverage cutting-edge tools—embracing AI as a daily craft instrument rather than an occasional shortcut. If you believe great design systems are a designer's highest-leverage output and that AI is fundamentally transforming how we build them, we want to talk to you!

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Design, architect, and refine reusable components and interaction patterns, focusing on robust structural relationships, and scalability

• Write clear component specifications, usage guidelines, and standards, leveraging AI to speed up drafting and maintain comprehensive documentation

• Utilize modern, AI-powered developer and design tools (e.g., Cursor, Devin, Claude) to build live prototypes, validate architectural feasibility, and accelerate production implementation

• Partner directly with UI engineers to align design intent with web technologies, ensuring component structures are highly responsive, accessible, and easily consumable

• Actively support product design teams during their adoption of the design system, assisting them in applying component architecture principles and troubleshooting complex layouts

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. You adapt to what’s needed, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

• You seek out challenges because you are energized by finding solutions, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

• You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

• You have a deep curiosity for how things work and are energized by solving complex technical challenges. You believe in the power of technology to accelerate transformation and are always looking for a better, more secure, and scalable way.

• You are skilled at distilling complex problems, user needs, and technical concepts into clear, simple, and actionable plans. You are a precise communicator who brings clarity and focus to every interaction.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

• 6+ years of Product/UX Design experience, with at least 1–2 years of dedicated contribution to a multi-product design system

• Demonstrated expertise in systematic component architecture, understanding how individual components roll up into larger patterns, templates, and full applications

• Proven experience integrating AI assistants or modern generation/prototyping tools into your daily design and development workflow to accelerate outcomes and build interactive layouts

• Familiarity with accessibility frameworks (such as WCAG 2.1/2.2 standards) and designing with structural layouts built for responsiveness

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

• Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to generate, customize, or preview coded components, bringing designs closer to working code.

• Literacy in modern frontend technologies (e.g., React, CSS/HTML, token-driven theming, or JSON properties), enabling you to inspect and discuss code structures directly with developers

• Experience designing systems for cyber security, infrastructure, developer tools, or other highly technical/complex domains
